sources.title: CTC Models (Fast ASR) | facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) model family in the omnilingual-asr system. CTC models provide fast, efficient automatic speech recognition suitable for real-time and high-throughput transcription scenarios. These models prioritize inference speed while maintaining competitive accuracy across 1600+ languages.
